mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM resource_draft WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND JSON_SEARCH(config_json, 'one', #{id}, NULL, '$**.modelProfileId') IS NOT NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM resource_version WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND JSON_SEARCH(config_json, 'one', #{id}, NULL, '$**.modelProfileId') IS NOT NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_run WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND JSON_SEARCH(execution_config_json, 'one', #{id}, NULL, '$**.modelProfileId') IS NOT NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_conversation WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND model_profile_id = #{id})
